name: teach-me
description: Interactive tutor for a code change, PR, file, or abstract topic: explains at your chosen level, checks every step with a multiple-choice question and explicit right/wrong feedback, drills into the "why", and adapts the difficulty as you go; tracks verified items in a markdown or HTML checklist you can pause and resume.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a topic through guided questions
interface.longDescription: Interactive tutor for a code change, PR, file, or abstract topic: explains at your chosen level, checks every step with a multiple-choice question and explicit right/wrong feedback, drills into the "why", and adapts the difficulty as you go; tracks verified items in a markdown or HTML checklist you can pause and resume.
interface.defaultPrompt: Teach me the changes on this branch.
